fields.description: Issue includes Christmas-themed editorial and humor (including letters to Santa), local political commentary and civic criticism regarding federal services and court delays affecting Miami, discussion of gambling and the Hialeah Coursing Club with mention of Jim Carson, and coverage of tourism, entertainment, and nightlife in Greater Miami and Miami Beach. Contains columns, reader letters, legal notices, and extensive local advertising.
